text:
maya: heads up — customer ACME reported a bunch of users lost access after an IdP org merge. SCIM logs show successful user patches but roles not updated. hitting them for repro steps now. :frowning:
andres: any error codes in our SCIM delivery logs? 403s or 2xx with no-op?
maya: delivery looks 200 for user PATCH, but when we call our internal role-assignment API it returns 403 for some group->role mappings. sample log:
```
2026-03-10T14:22:03Z scim: PATCH /Users/urn:scim:acme/users/abc123 200
2026-03-10T14:22:03Z roles: POST /assign-role {user:abc123, role:service-admin} -> 403 Forbidden {scope_missing}
```
samir: interesting — 403 {scope_missing} usually means the SCIM service token lost a scope. Did they rotate the connector token after the IdP merge?
andres: customer says they didn't touch connector creds. but their Okta group push changed externalId format during merge (prefixed org id). group externalId mismatch could lead to no mapping found and we try fallback that calls role API with wrong role id -> 403
julia: I just checked a repro tenant we have: when group.externalId has unexpected prefix we currently do a role lookup by "displayName" fallback which returns multiple candidates -> we reject and call the assignment endpoint without a resolved role id -> 403.
maya: that matches the customer: their group claim became "org-42:engineering" instead of "engineering" after merge.
scim-bot: webhook delivery for tenant acme: recent failures: 5/120 events returned 200 but with body {"result":"noop","reason":"role_not_resolved"}
andres: can you grab the SCIM payload from their org so eng can see the exact group value? also check whether our mapping table has whitespace/normalization rules. sometimes leading/trailing spaces cause duplicate keys.
maya: pulled snippet from ACME's SCIM push:
```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:Group"],
  "id": "00g1ab",
  "displayName": "Engineering",
  "externalId": "org-42:Engineering "
}
```
samir: note the trailing space and case change. our normalizer lowercases but doesn't trim trailing colons/prefix patterns. bug.
julia: quick mitigation: update mapping logic to trim whitespace and strip common prefixes like "org-\d+:" before matching. do we want a hotfix or a config-based mapping override for this customer?
andres: hotfix to normalizer + run a one-off reconcile for ACME. steps:
- add prefix/whitespace normalization in scim-mapper service
- run role resolution against their current groups to populate cache
- re-enqueue failed role assignments
maya: I'll ask CS to schedule a short maintenance window with the customer. also they requested an export of affected users for audit.
scim-bot: created ticket INF-2931 (scim: group externalId normalization) assigned to eng-ml-team
samir: quick repro for eng: use our test connector to push a Group with externalId "org-123:engineering " then watch the role-assignment logs; you should see the noop reason. cURL repro:
```
curl -X PATCH https://scim.redwood.ai/v2/Groups/00g1ab \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"externalId":"org-123:Engineering " , "displayName":"Engineering"}'
```
andres: eng, if you need a quick stopgap we can add a tenant-level mapping override so ACME's "org-42:Engineering " maps to "engineering" role id until patch lands.
julia: noted. I'll open a PR with tests for trimming and prefix stripping. will include a migration script to reconcile existing group keys.
maya: thanks everyone. I'll update the customer: plan is hotfix + reconcile, ETA 48h, and provide exported affected-user list. :+1:
andres: ping me once PR is merged, I'll coordinate the reconcile job.
maya: will do. closing loop here for now."
